text:
Great question! Unfortunately, the longer guarantee doesn't apply to plants you bought before joining. The 90-day Plant Care Guarantee covers **plants ordered while your membership is active**.

For plants you ordered before joining, the standard **30-day guarantee from delivery** still applies. If one of those plants is still within its 30 days, you can make a claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant plus a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days.

Any plants you order after you join will get the full 90 days from delivery.

If you'd like help with a specific plant, just let me know. Happy planting! 🌿
